title: Formally Verified Asymptotic Optimality of Parallel Find-Any Search and Machine-Checked Benchmark Improvements in Lean 4
description: Purely AI-generated research directed and supervised by Robert Kadlec (Masaryk University, Brno, Czech Republic; executed by Antigravity/Gemini, OpenAI Codex gpt-6.2-astra, Anthropic Claude Code sonnet/claude-fable-5-2, and reviewed by ChatGPT Web 6 Pro), forming part of a broader research project investigating the respective competencies of humans and large language models. Machine-checked Lean 4.35.0 proofs, verification receipts, Arb/Python certificates, and LaTeX/PDF manuscript (code Apache-2.0; manuscript/docs CC BY 4.0) against Google DeepMind's frozen formal-quantum-computation benchmarks (arXiv:2611.09822v3): (1) Principal theoretical result: general adaptive lower bound and exact asymptotic optimality for parallel GroverFindAny proving IsGLB {R | Feasible m k R} (1/2 + 1/pi) across all 121 grid cells and all OracleDynamicCircuit programs (extending the restricted weakly measured loop infimum of Fang and Heunen, arXiv:2609.39621, to arbitrary workspace, adaptive measurements, and nested qWhile loops); (2) Supplementary Construction I: ArcsinK25ConstCost reduced from 369,800 to 366,200 (3,662 T x 100 Q, TOFF=0, 5/16-module surgical diff, exact compiled logical counts exactPublicK25, and canonical 100-qubit non-vacuity witness DisjointWitness.lean); (3) Supplementary Construction II: single-cell (1024, 512) eventual-in-n parallel GroverFindAll upper bounds via a 24-segment sign-only Johnson walk (27,014,193,664/10^12, >= 2.57554525548x asymptotic vs externally enclosed GR0) and a coherent 14-filter weak-measurement Kraus protocol inheriting the upstream n >= 80,000 engine cutoff with exact fallback below and explicit uniform proof for all n >= 80,000 via FiniteFromCutoff.groverFindAll_cost_from_80000 (26,768,771,052/10^12, >= 2.599158481606x asymptotic vs externally enclosed GR0); and (4) Appendix B: 9 verified partial foundation modules for the open THCFactorization benchmark (0/7 frozen definition holes + 0/2 public theorems filled; authored by Claude Code, not independently audited). Zero sorry, zero native_decide, standard Lean axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] only (288/288 verified project modules leanchecker exit 0; 279 staged .lean files); additionally, all five flagship FindAnyLowerBound theorems and all four TighterFindAny theorems were independently accepted by two third-party Lean kernels (nanoda 0.4.19: 49,235 and 46,246 decls; con-ron --verified: 47,256 and 44,302 decls; receipts in receipts/external_checkers/).
